data.title: Context Window
data.tagline: The total amount of input and output a model can process in one request
data.learningOutcome: You can identify which messages and files use space in a request’s context window.
data.description: After a long chat, “follow the first requirement” can fail if that requirement was not included in the current request. More context capacity does not make every piece of information relevant.

learning.assumes: You have pasted long text, uploaded files, or asked several follow-up questions.
learning.outcome: You can identify which messages and files use space in a request’s context window.

explanation.title: Shared space
explanation.text: System prompts, conversation history, files, and response space all share the same total context window limit.

explanation.title: Output truncation is separate
explanation.text: Input context and max output tokens are separate (output truncation is usually due to reaching the output limit, not necessarily a full window).

explanation.title: Bigger isn't always better
explanation.text: A larger window doesn't mean you can cram everything in—irrelevant material dilutes the AI's attention and causes it to drift.

data.boundary: A larger window does not mean you should include every file. Irrelevant material can bury the point.

lessonPractice.title: An Agent starts missing newly added requirements and replies often cut off. Before continuing the same task, what should you do first?

options.label: Identify the rules, material, and recent decisions the task needs, summarize older content, and reserve answer space
options.feedback: Correct. Prioritize material the current task needs, compress older content, and leave room for a response.

options.label: Keep every input and reduce the response reserve as much as possible
options.feedback: Without enough response space, the model may still be unable to complete the answer.

options.label: Send another message and paste the remaining material there
options.feedback: The new message also consumes context. Adding more without removing noise makes the limit worse.

data.agentPrompt: Before continuing this task, list the rules, files, and recent decisions that must remain, then compress older material into a short working brief. Show me that brief and the material you recommend excluding for confirmation before proceeding; do not assume you can delete the current conversation.
